description: In the corresponding master list there is exactly one element holding the scheduler configuration.
See also man page sge_sched_conf(5).

attributes.name: algorithm
description: Deprecated and may be removed in the future.
Was intended to differentiate settings for different scheduling algorithms.
There is exactly one algorithm called default.

attributes.name: schedule_interval
description: Fixed interval (time value) defining how often scheduling runs are done.

attributes.name: maxujobs
description: The maximum number of *running* jobs per user.

attributes.name: queue_sort_method
description: For scheduling jobs the queue instances the sort order can be specified as
- seqno: requires that sequence numbers are defined in the queue definitions
- load: sorting is done by load, @see also load_formula

attributes.name: job_load_adjustments
description: Adds virtual load to just started jobs.

attributes.name: load_adjustment_decay_time
description: How fast to decay virtual load added via @see job_load_adjustments.

attributes.name: load_formula
description: Algebraic expression based on load values and weighting factors.

attributes.name: schedd_job_info
description: Boolean which defines if information why jobs cannot be schedules shall be made available.

attributes.name: flush_submit_sec
description: Forces scheduling run n seconds after job submission.

attributes.name: flush_finish_sec
description: Forces a scheduling run n seconds after a job finished.

attributes.name: params
description: Arbitrary list of scheduler parameters, usually name-value pairs.

attributes.name: reprioritize_interval
description: Time value defining how often running jobs will be reprioritized (based on policies).

attributes.name: halftime
description: Halftime for decaying sharetree usage.

attributes.name: usage_weight_list
description: Defines how different usage values (e.g. cpu, mem, io) are weighted in sharetree calculations.

attributes.name: compensation_factor
description: Defines how fast too low or too high sharetree usage is compensated.

attributes.name: weight_user
description: Weighting factor for functional policy on user configuration.

attributes.name: weight_project
description: Weighting factor for functional policy on project configuration.

attributes.name: weight_department
description: Weighting factor for functional policy on department configuration.

attributes.name: weight_job
description: Weighting factor for functional policy on job shares (qsub -js).

attributes.name: weight_tickets_functional
description: Weight of functional policy as compared to other ticket policies.

attributes.name: weight_tickets_share
description: Weight of sharetree policy as compared to other ticket policies.

attributes.name: weight_tickets_override
description: Weight of override policy as compared to other ticket policies.

attributes.name: share_override_tickets
description: Boolean defining if every job gets the same amount of tickets from a sharetree node
or if tickets shall be distributed over the jobs belonging to a sharetree node.

attributes.name: share_functional_shares
description: Boolean defining if functional shares of any object instance are shared among
all the jobs associated with the object

attributes.name: max_functional_jobs_to_schedule
description: The maximum number of functional pending jobs to schedule using the brute-force method.

attributes.name: report_pjob_tickets
description: Report pending job tickets to the qmaster via scheduler order or not.

attributes.name: max_pending_tasks_per_job
description: The number of array tasks per pending job to schedule. Helps to reduce scheduling overhead.

attributes.name: halflife_decay_list
description: A list of halflife decay values (UA_Type).

attributes.name: policy_hierarchy
description: Defines the Order of the ticket computation.

attributes.name: weight_ticket
description: Weight of the ticket policies (functional, override, sharetree) as compared to other policies.

attributes.name: weight_waiting_time
description: Weight of the waiting time policy as compared to other policies.

attributes.name: weight_deadline
description: Weight of the deadline policy as compared to other policies.

attributes.name: weight_urgency
description: Weight of the urgency policy as compared to other policies.

attributes.name: weight_priority
description: Weight of the posix priority as compared to other policies.

attributes.name: max_reservation
description: The maximum number of resource reservations. 0 disables resource reservation.

attributes.name: default_duration
description: Default duration assumed for jobs that specify no h_rt/s_rt.
